# GPUI Kit palette data

Extracted color values and original author/source metadata from GPUI Kit0.7.1 commit `87d10ae5e1299d1be18670a37570c5402f952e34`, `themes/*.json` and `crates/component/src/theme/default-{theme,colors}.json`. Syntax highlight data and documentation prose are not included. The source repository licenses its software under Apache-2.0; the license is retained here. Individual palette origins and authors are retained in palettes.json. CUI generates an adaptation to its supported semantic tokens; unsupported gradient brushes are recorded explicitly.
